text:
maya: hey folks — can someone eyeball PR #4321? touches batching heuristics + kv-cache eviction + a tiny change to the attention kernel selector. hoping to merge tomorrow AM before the canary. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321 :eyes:

alec: pinged the thread — quick q: what's the risk if batching window increases under heavy tail? did you run rps/latency sims?

maya: good call. i ran a 30m traffic replay with synthetic tails — net throughput +4% and p99 latency up ~6ms on 4k seqs. worst-case KV miss increases token compute by ~3%. i added those numbers in the PR description.

ryan: looking now. initial glance: attention-kernel selector change seems fine but i want to double-check fallback for older model shapes. can you paste the selector diff?

maya: sure — snippet from the patch:
```
# choose kernel by (arch, seq_len_bucket)
def select_kernel(model):
    if model.arch == 'flash' and seq_len < 2048:
        return 'flash_opt_v2'
    return 'generic_attention'
```
also added a feature flag `runtime.attn_selector_v2` guarded off by default for dedicated.

sam: infra-bot shows CI running — test/bench passed on x86 but gpu-regressions still pending. i'll run a quick local gpu bench on g4 for the 8k seq replay. can you outline the kv eviction change?

maya: kv eviction: switched from LRU-based eviction every N tokens to a soft TTL + size cap to avoid eviction storms. change is ~10 LOC, config: `kv.max_entries=200000, kv.soft_ttl_ms=120000`. rationale in PR comment.

alec: small concern: soft TTL might let stale prefixes persist if a low-qps tenant streams long contexts. could blow memory. do we have a per-tenant mem cap?

maya: good point — we added per-tenant cap `kv.per_tenant_max_entries=50000` and a background sampler that trims oversized tenants. i'll add explicit docs in the config.md.

ryan: also, please ensure the eviction sampler uses atomic counters — i remember a race when trimming during ongoing write. add a CAS or lock.

maya: noted. will add CAS. that should be a tiny change.

sam: ran gpu bench: no regressions on throughput, p99io up ~3ms with attn selector on for 4k/8k. looks safe. i left a comment on PR re: unit test for sampler.

alec: reading PR now, left 2 inline comments (race + missing metric for kv_evictions/sec).

maya: thanks. i'll push a patch addressing race + metrics within the hour. can someone quota-approve the runtime change for Dedicated? need one infra approval to change default config in the deploy. @alec @ryan

alec: i'll approve config change after the race fix and a metric. if sam's bench looks good and CI passes, :+1:.

ryan: same. request a canary deploy (10%) with attn_selector_v2 on and kv soft-ttl to monitor evictions. set alert on kv.evictions.rate > 100/s.

infra-bot: CI status: build #3402 passed, gpu-regressions job queued, e2e integration scheduled.

maya: updated PR with fix + metric + test. tagging for review again. thanks all :pray: any final blockers?

sam: none from perf side. :shipit: after infra agrees on canary config.

alec: approved in GitHub. leaving note to ops to run canary. :white_check_mark:

ryan: approving after canary monitoring dashed. setting a watch.

maya: awesome — i'll coordinate with ops for a 10% canary tomorrow 08:00 PST and follow up in this thread with any anomalies. thanks everyone! :tada:
